Denim Wear / Latest Work

Denim Shirt.

  • PREMIUM COTTON DENIM
  • OVERSIZED FIT
  • VINTAGE WASH
  • CUSTOM EMBROIDERY

A premium denim shirt designed with an oversized, relaxed silhouette for a modern streetwear look. Made from durable cotton denim with a vintage faded wash, featuring a button-front construction, drop shoulders, and statement embroidery details.

Fully customizable with custom washes, embroidery, artwork, pockets, stitching, buttons, patches, labels, and sizing—ideal for denim, streetwear, and contemporary fashion brands.

Manufacturing specs at a glance:

  • Fabric: 100% Cotton Denim
  • Weight: Approx. 8–10 oz Denim
  • Fit: Oversized / Relaxed Fit
  • Construction: Button-front with chest pocket & drop shoulders
  • Sleeves: Relaxed Half Sleeves
  • Wash: Vintage / Faded Blue Wash
  • Branding: Custom embroidery, patches & printing
  • Customization: Wash, artwork, pockets, buttons, labels & sizing available
